documents.duplicate_rule: two invoices with the same entity_id, currency, total_minor and identical line_items are duplicates; the one issued later is the duplicate
documents.invoice_refs: list of {invoice_id, amount_minor} in payment currency, or null if none

fx.rate_date_rule: use the fx.csv row whose date equals the calendar date of the document timestamp (invoice issued_at / payment timestamp) in the company timezone
fx.rate_semantics: rate = units of target_currency per 1 unit of source_currency
fx.settlement: AR is relieved at the invoice booking rate on cumulative amounts: relief = convert(applied_after) - convert(applied_before); the remaining difference to CASH is posted to FX_GAIN_LOSS

accounts.FX_GAIN_LOSS: realised FX difference on settlement and rounding
accounts.UNAPPLIED_CASH: cash received but not applied to any invoice

ledger.posting: invoice: Dr AR / Cr REVENUE; receipt: Dr CASH / Cr AR per invoice_ref (+ Cr UNAPPLIED_CASH for any unapplied part, FX_GAIN_LOSS balances); refund: Dr REFUNDS / Cr CASH

period.rule: an operation belongs to the period iff start <= timestamp < end, comparing instants; calendar dates are taken in the company timezone

rounding.unit: one minor unit of the target currency
